title: Potential-based against direct surrogates for CO2 near Tc
description: A network for the Helmholtz energy (every property a derivative of it; MLP and input-convex variants) against one network output per property, on the same mixed CoolProp data of supercritical CO2 near the critical point, at equal data and steps: accuracy inside the training region and in two extrapolation regions, thermodynamic-identity violations, stability; 5 seeds with 95 % intervals.
